spans.text: That was quite an explosion. Those Sangvis units didn't even have time to run.
How did you know we're right next to their powder keg storage, Makarov?
I found out when I was searching for Nagant's warehouse.
You've thought of everything, haven't you. As expected of the one who's earned even Mosin-Nagant's trust.
Hey, Makarov only got the chance because I'd forgotten where the warehouse was! It's all thanks to me!
It all started because of you... By the way, what's that thing you're clutching?
No idea. It has Griffin's logo on it so I just took it with me.
Enough chit-chat. We're not completely out of danger yet.
Commander, are you there? We can't go back the way we came.
Please lead us away from the battlefield.
